releases.name: Kevin v2.2.1 Docs sync
releases.body:
# Kevin v2.2.1 — Docs sync. The paper trail catches up

v2.2.0 Harbor fixed the code and forgot the paper: badges still said old versions, package READMEs stopped at 2.0.0, package CHANGELOGs stopped at 1.5.0. **2.2.1 syncs every public surface** — zero behavior change, zero migration, zero contract drift.

> **No new code paths, no new promises.** The only bytes that change meaning are the version strings.

## 📦 Install

// opencode.json — plugin stays exactly as before
{ "plugin": ["@jmtrin/opencode-kevin"] }

npm install @jmtrin/opencode-kevin@2.2.1
npm install @jmtrin/kevin-core@2.2.1        # zero deps, host-agnostic
npm install @jmtrin/kevin-mcp@2.2.1         # stdio bridge 2.2.1 (same WAL, pinned)
npm install @jmtrin/opencode-kevin-tui@2.2.1

Bridge still `npx -y @jmtrin/kevin-mcp --repo <16-hex>`. DB already at `016` — nothing migrates.

## 📄 READMEs synced — every package tells the current version

The drift, measured file by file:

| File | Was | Now |
|---|---|---|
| `README.md` (root) | badge `2.1.0`, tests `1509` | badge `2.2.1`, tests `1538`, + "What's new in 2.2.1" |
| `packages/core/README.md` | badge `2.0.0`, What's-new stopped at 2.0.0, Upgrade pinned `2.0.0`/`014` | badge `2.2.1`, TOC + sections backfilled (2.1.0 Relay, 2.2.0 Harbor, 2.2.1) |
| `packages/plugin/README.md` | badge `2.0.0`, TOC stopped at 2.0.0 (the 2.2.0 section existed, orphaned) | badge `2.2.1`, TOC completed, + 2.2.1 and 2.1.0 sections |
| `packages/tui/README.md` | badge `2.0.0`, What's-new stopped at 2.0.0, Upgrade pinned `2.0.0` | badge `2.2.1`, TOC + sections backfilled |
| `packages/mcp/README.md` | badge + ASCII header `2.0.0`, publish pin `2.0.0` | `2.2.1` everywhere + Relay/Harbor notes |

History untouched — no earlier section or block was rewritten, only appended to.

## 📒 Package CHANGELOGs revived

`packages/core/CHANGELOG.md` and `packages/plugin/CHANGELOG.md` were stopped at **1.5.0** — three releases behind. Both gain 2.0.0/2.1.0/2.2.0 backfill entries (package-scoped, sourced from the root CHANGELOG) + 2.2.1. (tui/mcp ship no CHANGELOG — unchanged.)

## 🔢 Version bookkeeping — the enabler

npm refuses republishing `2.2.0`, so the docs ride a patch bump:

```
root + core + plugin + tui + mcp → 2.2.1
cross-pins exact (plugin→core/tui, mcp→core), lockfile re-synced (version-only diff)
KEVIN_VERSION 2.2.1 · bench_persist package_version pin → 2.2.1
root CHANGELOG ## [2.2.1] (repo_hygiene requires newest heading == KEVIN_VERSION)
```

No migration, no contract change (C-07 stays `016`), no new tools/settings/metrics. Contract golden byte-identical.

## ❄️ Contract: deliberately untouched

No clause changes — the table from Harbor stands verbatim (`C-03` 27 tools, `C-05` 68 metrics, `C-07` `016`, `contract_version: 2`). Succession + frozen suites re-verified green against the untouched golden.

## ⏱️ Latency, still measured — not promised

No new scope, no path lengthened — same budgets-or-red rule:

| Scope | p95 | max |
|---|---|---|
| `tool.execute.before` | 2 ms | 10 ms |
| `tool.execute.after` | 5 ms | 25 ms |
| `chat.message` | 2 ms | 10 ms |
| `session.idle` | 150 ms | 600 ms |
| `dispose` | 50 ms | 250 ms |
| `mcp.read` | 25 ms | 100 ms |
| `mcp.write` | 50 ms | 250 ms |
| `skills.emit` | 25 ms | 100 ms |
| `mif.codec` | 25 ms | 100 ms |
| `sources.sync` | 50 ms | 250 ms |
| `chat.system.transform` | 15 ms | 50 ms |
| `session.compacting` | 15 ms | 50 ms |
| `event` | 5 ms | 25 ms |

`npm run bench:check` still fails on any breach; `kevin_doctor` still degrades.

## 📊 Value, still benchmarked — reproducibly

Same committed corpus (seed `1262835273`, digest `adecbdf4c7af82e2`), `k=5` — retrieval paths untouched, replay parity green:

| Arm | Precision@5 | Recall@5 | MRR |
|---|---|---|---|
| `none` | 0.000 | 0.000 | 0.000 |
| `recent-k` | 0.050 | 0.026 | 0.109 |
| `random-k` | 0.048 | 0.028 | 0.093 |
| **`kevin`** | **0.950** | **0.546

releases.name: Kevin v2.2.0 Harbor
releases.body:
# Kevin v2.2.0 — Harbor. The ship finally docks

v2.1.0 Relay reached for a second pair of hands but never made it onto the ship — its own entrypoint kept it out of the host. **Harbor does the docking work**: the plugin loads, every Desktop instance belongs to its own project, fresh databases tell the truth, and counts derive instead of rotting.

> **Load anywhere, belong somewhere.** A harbor adds no ships; it makes arrivals safe.

## 📦 Install

// opencode.json — plugin stays exactly as before
{ "plugin": ["@jmtrin/opencode-kevin"] }

npm install @jmtrin/opencode-kevin@2.2.0
npm install @jmtrin/kevin-core@2.2.0        # zero deps, host-agnostic
npm install @jmtrin/kevin-mcp@2.2.0         # stdio bridge 2.2.0 (same WAL, pinned)
npm install @jmtrin/opencode-kevin-tui@2.2.0

Bridge still `npx -y @jmtrin/kevin-mcp --repo <16-hex>`. One import moves (no shim, by design):

```js
import { KEVIN_CONFIG_KEYS, KEVIN_VERSION } from "@jmtrin/opencode-kevin/config";
```

## 🔌 The entrypoint is a door, not a warehouse

v2.1.0 shipped an entrypoint the host could never load: arrays, objects and strings next to the factory made the legacy loader throw `TypeError: Plugin export is not a function` on the first export — **0 of 27 tools registered, on every project, every boot**.

// before: 7 exports, 4 loader-FAIL — after: exactly 2, same reference
EXPORT_KEYS: ["KevinPlugin","default"]   // default === KevinPlugin → registered once

- **New module `packages/plugin/src/config.ts`** — owns `KEVIN_CONFIG_KEYS`, `REMOVED_SETTINGS`, `ERROR_LESSON_MODE_VALUES`, `KEVIN_VERSION` (re-exported from core, single source) and `performRekey` (+ `RekeyCounts`/`RekeyResult`, moved byte-verbatim). Pure constants + parameterized function: importing it never opens a database.
- **Additive `./config` subpath** (`types` first) — `name`/`main`/`exports["."]`/`exports["./tui"]` untouched (C-06 frozen). No compatibility re-export: that would reintroduce the bug by construction.
- **Guarded twice** — `tests/unit/plugin-loader-contract.test.ts` replicates `getServerPlugin` over the *compiled* entrypoint (exact-two-exports + same-ref), and `verify-pack` property **P8** (byte-identity + predicate) plus smoke **CS3** (predicate over the actually-installed tarball). Reintroducing `export const X = [...]` turns both red — probed, recorded, reverted.

## 🏠 Every instance belongs to its project

Under OpenCode Desktop one server process hosts N instances — and every one of them resolved the *server's* home: same `project_id`, same `repo_id`, own `.git/config` remotes ignored, `kevin_export` slicing the wrong corpus. Three facets, one fix site:

```
projectDir = input.directory ?? input.worktree ?? process.cwd()   // opts.projectRoot still overrides
RepoIdentity.resolve(projectDir, host)   // precedence declared > remote > host > path: untouched
```

- **Per-directory probe cache** — the process-global `cachedSurface` leaked instance A's project into instance B; surfaces are now memoized per project directory (frozen, never re-probed per directory).
- **Cwd-free walk-up** — plugin-root lookup tries the project chain first, keeps the server-cwd chain as fallback (the host package is the server's dependency). CLI single-project mode is byte-identical.
- **`projectId` follows the directory too** — fixing only the `repoId` input would have left half the bug alive.
- **Proven, not claimed** — `tests/integration/desktop_two_instances.test.ts`: two factories, one process, distinct `project_id == fingerprint(dir)`, distinct remote `repo_id`s, `kevin_export` isolation on a shared DB, host-source session identity, CLI-equivalence. Red 3/4 on old code, green on new.
- **Post-battery audit fix** — empty-string `directory` fell through `??` and would have scoped on `fingerprint("")`; now treated as absent (v2.1.0 semantics), pinned by unit + end-to-end tests.

> `opts.projectRoot` still wins everywhere. Tests keep their override; product

releases.name: Kevin v2.1.0 Relay
releases.body:
# Kevin v2.1.0 — Relay. The deletion that finally tombstones

Kevin united in Commonwealth. **Relay closes the loop** — what the source forgets, Kevin no longer orphans. One opt-in flag, one fingerprint diff, one tombstone as visible as `kevin_forget`.

> **One brain, every host, zero network — and now, zero orphans.** Deletion is a human-visible tombstone, never silent.

## 📦 Install

```json
// opencode.json — plugin stays exactly as before
{ "plugin": ["@jmtrin/opencode-kevin"] }
```

```bash
npm install @jmtrin/opencode-kevin@2.1.0
npm install @jmtrin/kevin-core@2.1.0        # zero deps, host-agnostic
npm install @jmtrin/kevin-mcp@2.1.0         # stdio bridge 2.1.0 (same WAL, pinned)
npm install @jmtrin/opencode-kevin-tui@2.1.0
```

Bridge still `npx -y @jmtrin/kevin-mcp --repo <16-hex>` — now `kevin_audit` also counts `source_deletions_total`.

## 🚦 Gate re-evaluated — honestly FAIL

Relay was conditional: second host only if the hosts asked for it.

```
ratio = weekly_downloads(@jmtrin/kevin-mcp) / weekly_downloads(@jmtrin/opencode-kevin)
PASS ⇔ ratio ≥ 0.50   (baseline 2026-08-25 base 475 → threshold ≈238)
data: api.npmjs.org/downloads/point/last-week/<pkg> — captured twice 7 days apart
```

**2026-08-30 real captures:** base **763** / mcp **219** → ratio **0.287** (<0.50) **FAIL**.
Raw JSON, URLs and dates in `docs/Kevin_v2.1.0_Defaults_Outcome.md` + `K16-021` appendix — `abs(0.287-0.287)/max=0` → 0% disagreement, no soak extension. Binding: **K21-002..004 `gate not taken`** — zero `packages/cc-adapter` code, C-14 stays 4 sources `opencode-plugin(10) · claude-memory(20) · codex-memories(30) · opencode-native(40)`, artifact stays **4 packages** (core, plugin, tui, mcp).

> A conditional gate is a gate, not a suggestion. No vibes.

## 🗑️ Deletion sync — the lifecycle that was missing

v2.0 inserted. v2.1 deletes — with the same visibility as `kevin_forget`.

```ts
// helper — pure, source-agnostic
collectDeletions(prev: Set<string>, current: Set<string>, source: string): DeletedInfo[]
// idle — after per-source scan loop, gated by the same sources_enabled + per-source flag
```

* **Gated `source_deletion_sync='0'`** (D21-03, opt-in in 2.1.0 → `'1'` in 2.2) — off by default, `kevin_config set source_deletion_sync 1` to reclaim space.
* **Fingerprint granularity** — diff `prevFps ∖ currentFps` per source; only `WHERE source=? AND status!='archived'` still present.
* **Archive + tombstone** — `UPDATE memories SET status='archived'` (idempotent, `changes()=0` → skip) + `SharedLayer.tombstone(entry_id)` only if `shared_entry_id` / `layer='shared'` ever exported; `source_deletions_total++` (`since 2.1.0`).
* **Cross-source safe, idempotent** — never touches another source's fingerprint; second idle emits nothing; fetch error (`try/catch`) → `fetchOk=false` → no mass-archive (the bug that would have orphaned on transient I/O is sealed).

```
scan → save 2 memories
delete one source file → next idle (flag=1) → 1 archived + tombstone line in .kevin/knowledge.okf + metric 1
second idle → 0 changes
```

## 🔍 Opencode-native probe — one const, no throw

```ts
export const NATIVE_CANDIDATE_PATHS = [
  ".opencode/memory/*.md",
  ".opencode/MEMORY.md",
] as const;
```

* Single-source location list — `grep -r "opencode/memory" packages/core/src` hits only that const (K21-006 grep guard).
* **Absent-safe** — every `statSync`/`readdirSync`/`readFileSync` in `try/catch`, absent → `health:{status:'absent'}` + `scan():[]`, never throws.
* `health:ok` → `found N files`; planted fixture `mkdir -p .opencode/memory && echo "# hello" > .opencode/memory/a.md` → next idle imports the line.

No new setting — reuses `source_opencode_native`.

## ❄️ Contract grows without breaking

Same job as Commonwealth: additive, not breaking.

| Clause | What changes | Since |
|---|---|---|
| **C-04** | `source_deletion_sync` | **2.1.0** |
| **C-05** | `source_deletions_total` |

releases.name: Kevin v2.0.0 Commonwealth
releases.body:
# Kevin v2.0.0 — Commonwealth. One repo, two hosts, one brain

Kevin remembered alone. **2.0 unites** — the same local SQLite, the same ranked recall, now sharded for scale and fed by every memory your machines already hold — with provenance on every line and an executable migration you can run, not just read.

> **One DB, every host, zero network.** OKF v3 shards by 2 000, sources merge by fingerprint, conflicts surface — never silently resolved.

## 📦 Install

```json
// opencode.json — plugin stays exactly as before
{ "plugin": ["@jmtrin/opencode-kevin"] }
```

```bash
npm install @jmtrin/opencode-kevin@2.0.0
npm install @jmtrin/kevin-core@2.0.0        # zero deps, host-agnostic
npm install @jmtrin/kevin-mcp@2.0.0         # stdio bridge 2.0.0 (same WAL)
npm install @jmtrin/opencode-kevin-tui@2.0.0
```

Bridge still `npx -y @jmtrin/kevin-mcp --repo <16-hex>` — now `kevin_sources show` tells you where every memory came from.

## ❄️ A frozen contract that grows without breaking

Five clauses join `C-01…C-09` — carried **verbatim**, never retyped — plus a machine-checked succession proof:

| Clause | Freezes | Since |
|---|---|---|
| **C-10** | `@jmtrin/kevin-core` public export list | 1.3.0 |
| **C-11** | MCP tool names + refusal vocabulary | 1.4.0 |
| **C-12** | Skills layout (canonical/mirrors/frontmatter) | 1.5.0 |
| **C-13** | MIF envelope + redaction semantics | 1.5.0 |
| **C-14** | MemorySources — names, precedence, dedup rule | **2.0.0** |

`contract_version: 2` — `kevin_contract` reports it, `tests/fixtures/contract/v2.json` enforces it, `diffContract` still fails loudly on any carried-clause drift. The retirement `import_host_memory → sources_*` is the only break — and it ships with its own translation, rolling exactly once.

Inspect it live: `kevin_contract { clause: "C-14" }`.

## 📂 OKF v3 — the file that learned to shard

`.kevin/knowledge.okf` was a single file. At 2 000 entries it is now a directory:

```
.kevin/knowledge/
  knowledge.okf       #  ≤2000 primary — what 1.x readers still see
  knowledge-002.okf   #  overflow, deterministic, zero-padded
  knowledge-003.okf   #  …
```

* **Reader walks all shards** sorted lexicographically, enforces global `entry_id` uniqueness — duplicate across shards → structured error naming both files.
* **Writer packs primary, spills overflow, collapses gaps** — write→write is byte-identical.
* **`okf_write_version='3'`** by default, `'2'` restores byte-exact legacy. Pre-2.0 readers see a deliberate partial view — documented, never hidden. `healHeader` rewrites every shard.

## 🧠 MemorySources — guests with name tags

Your machines already remember. Commonwealth just invites them in — on idle, in precedence order, never on the hot path:

```
opencode-plugin (10) ─┐
claude-memory   (20) ─┤─► scan ─► redact ─► quality ─► fingerprint dedup ─► save (source=adapter.name)
codex-memories  (30) ─┤         └─► source_dedup_skips_total++ · also_seen_by[]
opencode-native (40) ─┘              └─► topic clash → memory_conflicts kind='source_pair' (open, never auto-resolved)
```

* **Idle only** — after skills refresh, before snapshot flush. Per-source errors never block the next source; whole cycle bounded 10 s.
* **Incremental** — `memory_sources.meta_json` caches `{mtime,size}` per file; second scan with no changes emits zero candidates.
* **Provenance everywhere** — `kevin_trace` shows `source` per candidate, injected block adds `<!-- kevin:source=claude-memory -->` only when non-default, `kevin_audit.sources` reports health/last_sync/counts/skips, `kevin_sources show` (tool #27) is the 27th tool and it is show-only by design.

Four new settings, one retired:

```ts
"sources_enabled"        // '0' master gate — kills all sources when off
"source_claude_memory"   // '0' per-source gate
"source_codex_memories"  // '0' per-source gate
"source_opencode_native" // '0' per-source gate (absent-safe probe)
"okf_write_v

releases.name: Kevin v1.5.0 Diaspora
releases.body:
# Kevin v1.5.0 — Diaspora. Skills everywhere, memory you can carry

Kevin curated in silence. **1.5 projects it** — the same local SQLite, the same ranked recall, now as versioned skills mirrored to every harness and as portable `.mif` memory you can export, carry and import — with host memories from Claude and Codex welcomed in one gated pass.

> **One DB, many doors, zero network.** Skills are deterministic bundles; MIF is a vendor-preserving envelope; host import is `pending → dedup → redact → quality → save`.

## 📦 Install

```json
// opencode.json — plugin stays exactly as before
{ "plugin": ["@jmtrin/opencode-kevin"] }
```

```bash
npm install @jmtrin/opencode-kevin@1.5.0
npm install @jmtrin/kevin-core@1.5.0        # zero deps, host-agnostic
npm install @jmtrin/kevin-mcp@1.5.0         # stdio bridge 1.5.0 (unchanged wire)
npm install @jmtrin/opencode-kevin-tui@1.5.0
```

Bridge still `npx -y @jmtrin/kevin-mcp --repo <16-hex>`; skills need no daemon.

## 📚 The diaspora that already existed

The knowledge was already curated. Diaspora just gives it a second life:

```
curated memories ─► Materializer bundles ─┬─► .agents/skills/kevin-knowledge/SKILL.md + references/*.md (canonical)
                                          ├─► .claude/skills/kevin-knowledge/** (mirror, when on)
                                          ├─► .cursor/skills/kevin-knowledge/** (mirror, when on)
                                          └─► kevin_export {format:"mif"} → .mif → kevin_import {mif|claude|codex}
```

```
@mixin kevin-core 1.5.0 — 39 settings · 64 metrics · 013 · KEVIN_VERSION 1.5.0
  ├─ canonical: SKILL.md + references/<topic>.md  ≤80 index / <150 total, frontmatter name/metadata(hash,generated_at), manifest last
  ├─ mirrors: exact byte copy of canonical, prune on delete, single-prefix, discard external mirror edits silently
  ├─ MIF: {version:"1",exported_at,kevin_version,entries[]: {content,type,scope,source,created_at,vendor}}  redaction gated
  └─ host import: gate import_host_memory='1', capped walk 1 MiB / 5000, lstat symlink-safe, dedup by fingerprint, quality-gated inert
```

* **Canonical is a projection, mirrors are copies** — edit `SKILL.md` by hand → `EXTERNAL` → skipped, never overwritten. Delete a topic → `references/<topic>.md` pruned following canonical (H-03 fixed).
* **All bytes through the escape funnel** — every emitted line `escapeForFence → escapeForMarkerBlock` (C-09, `C-01` topic sanitize `[/\\:]`/`..` blocked).
* **Atomic, last-write-wins** — `tmp.<pid>.<rand>` + `renameSync` + `manifest.json` written LAST (C-02), corrupt manifest → `.corrupt` backup + `skills_manifest_corrupt_total`.

> If the recalled block, injected tokens, `kevin_audit.channels_v2` or `kevin_injections.channel` differ on identical fixtures vs `v1.4.0`, it is a **defect** of this release.

## ❄️ Zero behavior diff — by construction (plugin)

Plugin behaviour is byte-identical on the same fixtures:

* **Replay parity** — every `tests/replay/fixtures/*.json` mounted two ways (`KevinPlugin` with `KevinEnv` vs `replay()` core-native via `composeIdlePipeline`) → `memoriesCreated / injections / blocked / tokens` identical.
* **Contract byte-equal + additive** — `C-03` 26 tools frozen, `C-04` 35→39 (`+skills_*`/`import_host_memory`), `C-05` 61→64 (`+skills_emitted_total`/`mif_*`), `C-07` 013 — `contract_frozen 6/6` green, golden `v1.json` `39/64`.
* **Scans green** — `packages/core/src` exactly one `process.cwd()/homedir/node:os` site (`env.ts`), `skills-emit.ts` no longer imports `homedir`, `import-host` uses `lstatSync` not `statSync`, MCP stdio-only.

## 🧭 Four new surface atoms (and only four settings)

```ts
// packages/core/src/index.ts — four TEXT flags, compared with === "1"
"skills_canonical_dir"   // default '.agents/skills' — canonical root (validated: no absolute, no "..")
"skills_mirror_claude"   // default '0' — gate for .claude/skills copy
"skills_mirror_cursor"   /
